0.original: Lyse is not sure what to make of Isari.

24.original: Search for villagers in need of aid.

25.original: Speak with one of the Confederates.

49.original: Don't hurt me, please! I swear, I didn't do anything!

50.original: Heh heh. Saw the smoke, did you?

51.original: They didn't follow you, did they? I gave you enough time to escape?

52.original: Good, good... And don't worry─I'll try not to make a habit out of it.

53.original: Something definitely happened here. I see several people who look like they might be injured. Let's give them a hand and find out what we missed.

54.original: Hm? Do <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> need help? Oh, I'll be fine. It's nothing that won't heal. You should go after Lyse.

55.original: Ugh... What was it Thancred once said about battle scars and maidens? Naught worth repeating in polite company, I'm sure...

56.original: I see. I'm glad Soroban reached you in time...

57.original: The captain scoffed at first, but Tansui convinced him to at least muster our forces...

58.original: Thank you, my child. When the fighting started, I tried to run and hide, but fell and could not regain my feet...

59.original: I thought for sure that we would all be slaughtered, but the pirates drove them off! I never thought I would see the day when the Confederacy came to our aid!

60.original: Thank you for your concern, but I shall be fine. There is no more need for running, after all!

61.original: Uwaaaaaah!<hex:02100103>Oh, you're not an imperial. Is...is it over?

62.original: Kami be praised! I was certain she would have us all killed and burn Isari to the ground─or kill us after making us watch, or barricade us in our homes before putting them to the torch...

63.original: We had heard stories about the viceroy, but that was the first time any of us had seen her in the flesh...and I should be glad if I never see her again.

64.original: I remember you! You're the one who saved me from the Doman catchers!

65.original: Thanks to you, we managed to rescue the fishermen and my kidnapped comrades─one of whom joined the Confederacy with me long ago. It would've broken my heart to have had to bury him...

66.original: Oh, and if you're looking for the captain, you'll find him in the tavern.

67.original: You should've seen it! The captain was a bleedin' whirlwind of death!

68.original: Back already? What have you learned?

69.original: At the tavern, you say? In that case, we should find Lyse and speak with him together.
